package.description: Writes a bootable USB drive from an ISO or a disk image

en-US.description: Writes a bootable USB drive from an ISO or a disk image
en-US.longDescription: Burnout writes a Linux ISO byte for byte, and lays out a Windows ISO on FAT32 and exFAT. It checks what it wrote, and it refuses the disk that the system starts from. It writes a drive only from a shell that runs as Administrator.
en-US.name: Burnout

package.name: Burnout
